findings: A separate owned inner-mouth material was assigned to 206 inward-facing polygons.
Neutral, open, smile, and frames 1, 20, 33, and 61 retain the 171-pair body self-collision baseline.
Dark-wine base colors with emission strengths 0.08, 0.16, and 0.24 produce no meaningful reduction in the visible black band.
The black band is dominated by occlusion from the existing folded mouth topology rather than diffuse material color.
decision: Reject all r1113 variants and retain r1110 as the active offline study.
nextAction: Inspect the mouth fold as a topological subsystem and rebuild its contact loop instead of changing exterior lip position or interior color.
